name: x64dbg MCP Server
description: Exposes full x64dbg debugger control to agents over HTTP as a native plugin — breakpoints, stepping, memory reads, and register dumps for agentic reverse engineering.

skills.name: Breakpoint Control
skills.description: Sets, clears, and inspects breakpoints in a live debugging session so agents can drive execution to a point of interest.

skills.name: Memory Inspection
skills.description: Reads process memory and dumps CPU registers at any paused point in the debugged binary for agent analysis.

skills.name: Execution Stepping
skills.description: Steps into, over, and out of instructions under agent control, reporting the resulting debugger state each time.
